status: complete: run banked and read (L3_LEAD_BELOW_BAR), published

design.question: Under leave-one-family-out transfer at 4096 on 0015's eight sealed folds, does 0014's searched, standardised logistic L3 lead 0003's fixed incumbent by a preregistered margin of 0.02 (5200 of 260000 rows)? Eight L3 fits, one scoring each, the stitched count of correct rows read against 0015's banked incumbent count 22343 plus 5200 (L3_LEADS_INCUMBENT_UNDER_TRANSFER / L3_LEAD_BELOW_BAR); two flags banked beside it (the record's 0.05 margin; 0015's own transfer bar).
design.why_now: 0016's pre-freeze review adopted the finding that 'the primary reading was on the recipe 0015 showed transfers worst (M1), beside a raw logistic that hit its 400-iteration cap in every fold; a converged, standardised linear rule is the more informative comparator under transfer' (severity major) and, separately, argued that L3 on 0015's full folds is the most decision-relevant next measurement; eight fits of the standardised linear rule the record already has answer it without a new partition.
design.bar: L3's stitched correct count minus 0015's banked incumbent count 22343 >= 5200 rows (0.02 x 260000; the mixture reaches 0.105935) -> LINEAR_LEADS_UNDER_TRANSFER, else LINEAR_LEAD_BELOW_BAR; VOID on validity. Calibrated to the transfer regime (0015's raw logistic led by 1788 rows; the two 0015 cluster intervals are about 0.002 wide); whether the lead also reaches the record's in-distribution margin bar (13000 rows) is banked as a flag. The first draft's 0.05 bar, named 'reversal', was calibrated to the in-distribution scale and misdescribed: the in-distribution gap between this pair is 0.0078 the other way, so nothing would have been reversed (pre-freeze review).
design.controls: L3 on the full 800000-row pool within 0.005 of 0014's same-convention confirmatory refit 0.2317 (the same block, the same machinery); L3 on 0015's null block with shuffled labels <= chance + 0.02; 0015's sealed hashes for eval, pool, null block and every fold; three leakage counters per fold required to be 0; one ledger completion per fit; the recipe hash and scaled flag on every record; environment sealed and refused at launch; the mixture, the stitched vector and the margins recomputed by the reader, whose own mixture is the verdict's.
design.not_fitted: the searched model M4 (0014's selected recipe, 15874 s per fit at 800000 rows): eight folds would cost about 31 h of fit time; a separate, costed decision after this result

cost_anchors.extrapolation: 8 x about 1000 s + reproduction about 1200 s + null about 40 s + gathers: about 3 h; peak about 9.4 GB anonymous; must not run beside 0016's runner (MemAvailable precondition 14.5 GB and a refusal while another tools/pivot runner is alive)
